states.name: FIGHT
states.boundary: square enclosure, exert effort, spend energy

n_semantics: n:n is a variable exchange/encounter size for two interacting sides; n is a symbolic population or intensity count, not a measured organism count

variables.n: 1..20 interaction scale tied illustratively to globule growth rank

transition_logic.baseline: pressure<=10 and integrity>=60 and energy>=45 -> homeostasis, unless manually forced
transition_logic.fight: active defense; higher energy cost, maintains proximity; greater pressure mitigation
transition_logic.flight: moves away from stress; increases distance; moderate energy cost
transition_logic.hide: lowers exposure; slower recovery; minimal energy cost
transition_logic.recovery: energy recovers under low pressure; integrity recovers when pressure is low

provenance.simulation: Original deterministic illustrative toy model, not cellular measurements
provenance.tape: 21 @ globules with 20 growth steps retained unchanged
